title: A guessed product is priced as that product and answers with its own confidence ("milk" becomes Coconut Milk, Certain)
comment: DEFECTS row D-270 (and D-267). Reverts the identity gate df38ae3 added in app/src/catalogue-first.ts: itemFor() keeps the guessed product's barcode, brand and size, and safeEstimate() no longer clamps a guess to low confidence.
ifMissed: An answer key run over a catalogue that holds near-duplicate names with prices on the wrong one.
